controller: explicit leg position/velocity PD plus fixed-leg sagittal wheel LQR; same source in both engines
purpose: Untrained controller/reference transfer diagnostic, NOT a BeyondMimic policy or successful jump validation.
known_limitations: Wheel LQR was derived around fixed-leg ground contact, not jumping or large leg motion.
No learned policy, inverse-dynamics feedforward, flight controller, or landing controller.
Contact solver, collision approximation, and joint-limit solvers remain engine-specific.
